work.title: Software Engineer
points: I am developing the next-gen cross-platform control system app in Flutter/Dart
The entire project core and initial UI was developed solely by me
I also create tools and other helpful software for the team
I internally manage the Flutter app development tasks using Lean Kanban
I have also taken the lead on ensuring the security of the application, supplementing this with professional courses

work.title: Graduate Software Engineer
points: I worked as part of the applications team to develop the future control platform for the vacuum pumps in JavaScript
I also developed a UI diagram designer tool to help speed up development

work.title: Student Software Engineer
points: This was my year in industry placement as part of my computer science course at UKC
I was employed as part of the UI design team for the Edwards S3 project, implementing the interface which displays information about different systems, such as vacuum pumps
I followed the agile scrum process and I was part of stand-ups every morning, as well as sprint reviews and retrospectives at the end of each sprint

work.title: Student Software Engineer
points: This was a temporary summer placement in which I was tasked with developing a device to interface with the pump controllers
The main device was an ESP32 with an XLR connector which plugged directly into the pump controller
It used MQTT to publish the data so it could be aggregated and displayed clearly for the client
I designed a cross-platform application to display the data from the pumps, which also supported bluetooth connectivity

work.title: Floor Attendant
points: I worked in the arcade called Flamingo which is owned by Admiral Casino
My job was to refill prizes in machines, empty collected coins out the bottom of the machines, exchange tickets for prizes, and assisting customers with any issues they had
On occasion, I also exchanged and counted money
